title: Playing with Kid Rena, George Augustin and Lawrence Tucker
summary: He lists other bands he played with and recalls the George Augustin band personnel.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So what did you do after that? I can't imagine what you did after that, I'm sure. And everything, where did you go? You must have played with some other bands.
I played with Kid René, Jobs. I played with George Augustin.
I played with Howard, Sheik, and uh, Toker. I was Toker.
They didn't wear any kind of uniforms like Sheik, huh? They did, they did. That's a funny story. We used to go... It's worth getting that type of hands of Buddy Toker.
Me and Sheik both used to go play a job. There's two of us, play a job. Yeah? Trumon and trumpet.
What was this George Augustin, was his name, or Augustin?

Augustin, he was George Augustin. He used to play bass horn. Uh-huh. Who did he have with him, do you remember? I just remember his band. He was with us, with Lawrence Toker, I don't know. His son used to be a banjo player. His son was a banjo player.
Well, Lawrence Toker was in the same band. You, and George Augustin.
Do you remember anybody else was in that band?
I think Bill Hampton, he was in there. Uh-huh. He was playing banjo at the time. Bill Hampton. Is he? Melwin Frank on Clannett.
Oh, yeah. Is he a relation to, uh, Charlie Hamilton, Bill Hamilton? Charlie Hamilton. The piano player, there's no relation to him?
I don't think. He's a barber, so...
